options.name: endDate
options.description: The end date of the date range to query. Any format that satisfies [ISO 8601](https://www.w3.org/TR/NOTE-datetime-970915.html) is accepted. Recommended format is YYYY-MM-DD.

options.name: password
options.description: The password to authenticate. If not declared, the code will read the environment variable FORTIFLEX_ACCESS_PASSWORD.

options.name: programSerialNumber
options.description: The serial number of your FortiFlex Program.

options.name: serialNumber
options.description: The entitlement serial number. Instead of configId you can pass serialNumber to get results for one VM only.

options.name: startDate
options.description: The start date of the date range to query. Any format that satisfies [ISO 8601](https://www.w3.org/TR/NOTE-datetime-970915.html) is accepted. Recommended format is YYYY-MM-DD.

options.name: username
options.description: The username to authenticate. If not declared, the code will read the environment variable FORTIFLEX_ACCESS_USERNAME.
